Name: JP's Utility Machines - Frozen Microwave Food
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=6]﻿[color=#ff0000][u][center]F.M.M.[/center][/u][/color][/size][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]This mod adds new production machines, the microwaves, with which you can heat frozen meals and have the benefits of meals for a modest price and in a short time.[/i][/size][/color]



[color=#00ffff][size=6][b][i][u]Content:
[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]3 New production machines, the Microwaves, each with unique features that reflect the improvement in quality from the cheapest to the most expensive available.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]2 New objects, the Microwave Parts, with which you can build the microwaves together with other necessary materials.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]35 "New" objects, the frozen meals, which will produce their respective food once placed in the microwave.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[/font][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=6][b][i][u]Useful information:
[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]To start building the microwaves you will need to [color=#ffff00][u]purchase the recipes[/u][/color] as well as the [color=#ffff00][u]microwave parts[/u][/color] needed to build them from [color=#00ff00][u]Robin's store[/u][/color].[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Frozen food will be available at Joja. If Joja leaves the town, you can get the food from Krobus. The 35 Frozen Food will be distributed, there will be 5 in stock and they will change every day. The selling price of each Frozen Meal is 25% less than what you would normally get. [color=#00ff00]For example, the Pizza can be purchased for 600g, but the Frozen Pizza can be purchased for 480g. You still lose out, as the Pizza can be sold for 300g[/color]. [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Each box of frozen food will produce its own food, which will be the food of the game. They will keep their benefits and properties.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Some microwaves have [color=#ffff00][u]weather conditions[/u][/color] in which they will not work, when the bad weather is over, production will resume.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
